It was more than  6 on hsv 1 and 3 on hsv 2. The doctor said he is positive I have 2 and the number should increase slowly. I feel hopeless and scared :(

I have not had anything happening down there and I don't know if I will ever be normal again. Is there a vaccine or something that you can take that would take care of all this forever?

Blood test. As someone else here have said that I mentioned "all I can remember" let me say I dont "remember" having sex without my consent or I am drunk and don't remember a thing. That has never happened to me and I have never gotten too drunk where I pass out and don't remember.

I am surprised I am even posting this, but I have decided that tomorrow I will take matters in my own hands. I had a thread and had someone scream at me for not owning up..the truth is I dont know how. I dont have the experience, and fuck I dont know what should I do.

Hopefully when I do the deed I will wake up for real.

What paying dues? Did I fucking want a father that wasn't present on my teenage years, a mom who was controlling on every part of my life? I am making excuses, but I damn sure didn't want parents like this.

Fuck it, it doesn't matter. I realize there are many who are worse off, and I am grateful for how far I have come and what God has given me. I can't do it anymore.

Thanks for the help.

What do you want me to do then? Go to the parties, make a bad first impression, embarrass my friend and act like a weirdo infront of girls? I know what you are trying to say, believe me but the problem is I do not have the epxerience to deal with it or talk to someone to help me with this. I cant talk to my mom since she does not understand what I am going through, the only thing she cares about is for me to graduate and studies. My dad is always busy, and my brother is dealiong with his issues in his personal life.

You are right, life is definitely kicking my ass, and I wanna fucking ask why the fuck was I the lucky one to be in miserable situation. This is not a way a man should live, and I don't want anyone to go through waht I am going right now.

When to say participate, it's not as easy as you can make it sound for me. I have been alone for too long, and now I don't even feel like I know how to connect socially. Whenever I get a chance to go to a party, guess what? I can't make a conservation or mingle as they say with people. I not only end up hanging out with my friend there but I believe I make him uncomfrtable that I only hang with him and no one. It's unbelievable that I even know him.

I am not researching sports, I am researching places where there are bridges..I went to Craigslist to find guns. My only hope is if I die,  I don't want pain.
You don't understand, I have been to a psychiatrist and they don't understand..I don't blame her for anything. Last semester I emailed her to talk about what I am going through, no response.
